Riley CSM: Quick heads-up 7am PT next Wed is CrescentQBR. We need a compact one-slide playbook (flow + 3 bullets) and a live action ticker for follow-ups. Draft slides at ~v0.4 in drive.
Eva SE: I can handle demo choreography. Plan: 1 main path + 1 micro-fallback (local assets). Keep demos <4m each.
Jon AM: Please include a 30s renewal signal on the exec slide. Health dipped ~7% after onboarding slippage. Can someone pull tagged tickets and top reason codes?
Priya Enablement: I'll own the action ticker and capture enablement asks. Planning a 20-min rehearsal Tue afternoon to validate owners and handoffs.
deckbot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/crescent/qbr_v0.4  comments on slide 2 notes.
Riley CSM: Eva, add note: "Fallback: switch to quantized model if p95 > 300ms" (one line). Also add a 1-line contingency: "play GIF if streaming fails."
Eva SE: ack. Will add step bullets + offline gif. Also prepping a 60s smoke-check script for infra flakiness.
Jon AM: Risk snapshot short: (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on batch ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll draft a 2-line exec blurb with mitigations.
Priya Enablement: Action ticker template: `Owner | Task | ETA | Priority | Status | Follow-up`. I'll make it editable for owners, view-only for execs, and add a "confidence" column.
Riley CSM: Timeline: slides polished by Tue 9am, rehearsal Tue 3pm, ticker live in deck before meeting, exec intro: 45s health + 90s roadmap. Flag conflicts now.
Jon AM: I have a conflict during rehearsal  will upload a 90s voice note with my exec blurb.
Eva SE: I'll bring the laptop with local fallbacks. Tagging @eng-runtime for 1-2 bullets on recent perf variance for slide notes.
Priya Enablement: Live ticker link: https://sheets.redwood.com/crescent-qbr-actions  populating rows and pinging owners now.
Riley CSM: Great progress. Post-rehearsal we'll triage actions by priority and assign SLAs. Thanks team :rocket:
